text:
Wɔhyehyɛɛ Vancouver wɔ 1886, na ɛyɛ kuro kɛseɛ wɔ British Columbia na ɛyɛ metropolitan area a ɛto so mmiɛnsa wɔ Canada — port kɛseɛ wɔ Pacific na ɛyɛ Canada atɔeɛ mpoano ɛpono, a North Shore Mountains ne Pacific Ocean ahyia ho. Ne tebea a ɛda ɛpo ne mmepɔw ntam ma kuro no identity a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ Canada kuro kɛseɛ mu, na ne gyinabea sɛ wiase stage no daa adi bere a ɔyɛɛ 2010 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games host kuro, a wɔyɛɛ ne ceremonies wɔ BC Place.

Vancouver nso wɔ Canada soccer abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ paa mu baako. Wɔhyehyɛɛ organized association football wɔ British Columbia tete, na Pacific Coast Association Football League wɔ 1908 na wɔbɔɔ professional game a edi kan wɔ 1910. Fanfare a ɛwɔ mprempren mu baeɛ wɔ Vancouver Whitecaps, a wɔtɔɔ NASL's Soccer Bowl wɔ 1979 — nkunimdeɛ a ɛtwee nnipa bɛyɛ 100,000 kɔɔ victory parade wɔ Robson Street. Lineage no kɔɔ so wɔ 86ers, a wɔtoo wɔn din sɛ 1886, kuro no hyehyɛeɛ afe, a wɔkɔɔ so wɔ 1980s ne 1990s mu. Saa thread yi kɔ so kosi mprempren Vancouver Whitecaps FC, a wɔkɔɔ MLS mu wɔ 2011 na wɔbɔ wɔn agorɔ wɔ BC Place.

Kuro no football abakɔsɛm kɔ akyiri sen ne clubs. Vancouver kɔɔ 2015 FIFA Women's World Cup Final wɔ BC Place, na ɛhyɛ ne gyinabea sɛ Canada football hub kɛseɛ na ɛfata sɛ wɔde no kɔ wiase stage. Efi ne founding port-city mfiase kosi ne mprempren gyinabea sɛ MLS fie ne World Cup beaeɛ, Vancouver de ne Pacific geography a ɛyɛ nwonwa ne soccer culture a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛnea ɛte wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa hyia.
